description: Razvoj MetODologije za oceno potEncialnih poRušnih mehaNIzmov in izdelava ocen kondicijskega Stanja vodnogospodarskih prEgraDnih objektov (MODERNISED) - študija is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR. There are currently 71 registered water retention facilities in Slovenia, for which a special Operating and safety regime, of which 43 meet the criteria of large bulkheads. The oldest barriers in our area are klavže (Belčni Klavže, Putrih's Klavže and Sheep's lambs). Coverage: MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR. The portal shows the English title as "Development of Methodology for the Assessment of Potential Post-Rural Mechanisms and Preparation of Assessments of Condi" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR. Its keywords include hidrološka nesreča, hudourniška katastrofa. The listing shows 3 download or service links in HTML, PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
